selected_policy: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)
missing_information: Documentation of epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) (required as one of the two conservative management failures)
Clarification of the surgical level: Request is for C5-C6, but pathology is at C6-C7

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Patient describes severe, unremitting daily pain... Significant disability affecting work and daily activities of daily living.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Symptoms include unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: radiating down the right upper extremity into the shoulder and hand with numbness

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Physical exam findings include ANY of the following: dermatomal sensory deficit, motor deficit, reflex changes, shoulder abduction relief sign, nerve root tension sign
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Motor: 4/5 biceps weakness; Sensory: C6 sensory deficit; Reflexes: 1+ biceps; Provocative Signs: Spurling maneuver is positive.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following: prescription strength analgesics/NSAIDs/gabapentinoids for six (6) weeks, provider-directed exercise program for six (6) weeks, epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s)
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Completed 8 weeks (16 visits) of provider-directed physical therapy... Trial of NSAIDs (Meloxicam 15mg daily) and Gabapentin (300mg TID) with inadequate symptom relief.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Plain x-rays of the cervical spine (including flexion/extension lateral views) have been performed
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: EXAMINATION: CERVICAL SPINE 4-VIEW (AP, LATERAL, FLEXION, EXTENSION DYNAMIC VIEWS)... Dynamic flexion and extension lateral views: Normal

criterion_evaluations.criterion: MRI/CT shows neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that is concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: C5-C6 is completely normal. Severe disc extrusion is present at C6-C7 compressing C7 nerve root... DISCORDANT: Findings do not correlate with severe radicular symptoms at requested level.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: No unmanaged major depressive disorder, psychiatric illness, or substance abuse disorder.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Documentation of nicotine-free status with objective cotinine testing
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: TEST: URINE COTININE SCREEN (LC-MS/MS) RESULT: Negative... Specimen confirms tobacco / nicotine abstinence (>6 weeks duration)

notes: The request is denied due to a critical conflict between the requested surgical level and the imaging findings. The request is for CPT 63075 at C5-C6, but the MRI explicitly states 'C5-C6 is completely normal' and identifies the pathology (severe disc extrusion) at C6-C7. The policy requires imaging findings to be 'concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings' at the 'requested level(s)'. Additionally, the physical exam notes a C6 sensory deficit and biceps weakness, which anatomically corresponds to the C5 nerve root (exiting at C5-C6), further contradicting the C6-C7 pathology found on MRI. The patient meets all other criteria (conservative care, x-rays, nicotine status, mental health), but the level mismatch prevents approval.
